name: Renaissance Scrub Prototype
author: Lyle Mills
description: A control-layout prototype for word playback: select a number, seek to a frame inside it, hold that frame without a trigger, or trigger playback forward from the seek point.

controls.label: Word
controls.description: Selects one of eleven words: zero through ten.

controls.label: Position
controls.description: Chooses the held frame; a trigger plays forward from this point.

controls.label: Formant
controls.description: Shifts the apparent vocal-tract size without changing the played pitch.

controls.label: Rate
controls.description: Changes word playback speed around the original rate at noon.

outputs.main: The held or playing LPC speech frame.
outputs.aux: The LPC excitation signal before the vocal-tract filter.
